hook.name: WOOFiAggregator v1.0
hook.description: Aggregator hook that fills Uniswap v4 swaps through the WOOFiGateway into WOOFi's WooPPV2 oracle-priced market maker, returning a BeforeSwapDelta so the v4 pool itself holds no liquidity. Liquidity provision on the v4 pool is disabled, the hook is immutable and ownerless, and a protocol fee capped by a constant is taken on each swap. The gateway owner can pause it, allowlist tokens and cap swap size; the quote reverts in the same cases as the swap. WooPPV2 is an upgradeable proxy.
